articles.title: Plutonium Beta Released!
articles.desc: The wait is finally over! The Plutonium beta is now live, bringing a fresh new experience packed with features, improvements, and plenty more to explore. How else would you be reading this?

articles.title: New Music tech incoming.
articles.desc: We're working on something completely new for music lovers. A new type of music streaming service is currently in development, designed to bring a faster, cleaner, and more enjoyable way to discover and listen to music.

articles.title: New browsing engines.
articles.desc: We've taken another major step forward with our browsing technology. Plutonium now incorporates a remote browsing engine, giving users another powerful way to access content while improving compatibility and reliability across the platform.

articles.title: Stream Forever.
articles.desc: WE HAVE ANIME, SHOWS, AND MOVIES! Explore a growing selection of entertainment all in one place, with an experience built around making it easy to find something to watch whenever you want.

articles.title: UI overhaul.
articles.desc: The entire interface has received a major visual refresh. We've redesigned the experience to make Plutonium cleaner, smoother, and easier to navigate while giving the platform a completely fresh look. Just look at it!
